observations: All 48 global cases are shown, and all 24 primary independent cases appear in the local-error figure. Same-photon points track independent MC variance closely.
The 80/20/20 cases show larger global bias and local error. Correlated cases differ in sign by photon pattern, as permitted by the covariance formula.
These are finite static-training measurements; no attribution of all mean changes specifically to FSTS, and no video quality or sensor-variance claim.
